This small perennial plot is mine, and I will manage it carefully with what my household can afford. I do not plan to buy chemical fertilizer because it is costly and often comes late, but I will put some manure or compost there and rely mostly on our usual planting material. We will work it ourselves, and because this is Amhara and I depend on the rains, I will not irrigate or use much chemical spray.
